description: The month of November is expected to bring several smartphone launches across flagship and mid-range segments. Brands have been preparing new devices not just for China, but for India and other global markets as well. The upcoming lineup includes camera-focused flagships from the Vivo X500 series. Meanwhile, Motorola could introduce its second model in the Signature lineup in the form of Signature 27. Some launches have already been confirmed for this month, while others are based on reports and leaks.
title: Upcoming Smartphones in November 2026: Vivo X500 Series, Xiaomi 18 Pro Series, Oppo Reno 17 Series and More

description: The Indian smartphone market witnessed the launch of 14 different handsets in India in October 2026. The Oppo Find X10 series, comprising the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max and Oppo Find X10, was launched in India in October as the tech firm’s flagship smartphone lineup. Similarly, the Vivo X Fold 6 is the tech firm’s latest book-style foldable in the country, launched last month. Moreover, Oppo celebrated 10 years of the F series in October with the launch of the Oppo F35 5G and Oppo F35 Pro 5G. The Vivo V80 was launched in India along with the Vivo X Fold 6 and Vivo S2 FE on October 6.
title: Smartphones Launched in India (October 2026): Oppo Find X10 Series, Vivo X Fold 6 and More

description: Here are five of the best laptops for students in India priced under Rs. 1 lakh. These models are suitable for attending online classes, taking notes, preparing assignments, editing documents and handling everyday productivity tasks.
title: Best Student Laptops Under Rs. 1 Lakh in India: Asus Vivobook 16, MacBook Neo, More

description: The sub-Rs. 10,000 TWS earbuds segment has several options with active noise cancellation, multipoint connectivity and support for high-resolution audio codecs. This list covers five models from Realme, JBL, OnePlus, Noise and Huawei, with prices starting at Rs. 5,999. The OnePlus Buds 4 and Realme Buds Air 8 Pro offer features such as adaptive ANC and low-latency gaming modes, while the Noise Master Buds 2 add Bose-tuned audio. Huawei and JBL round out the selection with their own set of audio and connectivity features.
title: Best TWS Earbuds Under Rs 10,000 in India: Top Picks From Realme, JBL, Huawei, and More

description: EPFO has introduced WhatsApp-based services to make it easier for members to access essential provident fund (PF) information. Subscribers can check their EPF balance, view their last five transactions, download their passbook, and access other services directly through the newly launched service. Here's how to use EPFO services on WhatsApp.
title: EPFO Services on WhatsApp: How to Check PF Balance, Download Passbook, View Last Transactions and More

description: With most users owning two SIM cards, it does make sense if you need one for internet and calling, while the other is reserved solely for work calls. In such cases, telecom operators (thanks to TRAI) have come up with interesting plans to meet every user’s requirements. We take a closer look and compare the best voice-only prepaid plans available.
title: Jio vs Airtel vs Vi: Voice-Only Prepaid Plans Compared
